narrative: 前景中的人物一开始占据画面，随后螺旋镜片转动，房间里的一张脸接管了画面。没有剪辑。
虚焦本身就是这句话的内容。当“谁重要”发生变化，而地理关系保持不变时使用它。
如果两个平面必须同时保持清晰，或者你只需要一张静态的浅焦肖像，这就用错了工具。如果两端都没有清晰的画面，你就没有真正完成移焦。
how: 标记两个距离。让景深足够浅，只有一个平面清晰锐利，通常用接近T2光圈的50mm到85mm镜头。
跟焦器或遥控马达把螺旋对焦环从A点走到B点。摄影机通常锁定或缓慢移动，让虚实转移成为唯一的事件。
随着镜片移动，镜头呼吸效应可能会让画面略微放大。提示词：a focal shift: the plane of sharpness traveling from one fact to another。
对于视频，从前景物体拉焦到主体，或反向操作。
when: 用在前景中的一只酒杯、一把枪或一个旁听者，把注意力让给必须回答的人的那个瞬间。不要把它当成装饰用在一张没有第二平面的单人脸部特写上。
vs: 焦点转移（Rack Focus）是标准的两点式转焦，通常约两秒，构图保持不变；移焦（Focal Shift）则是把移动中的焦平面本身作为事件，包括慢速转焦、快速转焦，或连续多次转焦。
浅焦（Shallow Focus）是一种状态：某个平面已经清晰；而移焦是这些状态之间的转换过程。
examples_film: 《毕业生》（The Graduate）通过选择性对焦，在本杰明和周围人物之间组织观众的注意力；《血色将至》（There Will Be Blood）在坚硬的室内场景中使用同样的语法：谁在房间里“为真”发生变化，却没有剪辑。
这是语法，不是可以照搬的画面。
mistakes: 常见的错误近亲是剪辑，或者在转焦过程中细节发生变形。破绽是两个平面都清晰，或者随着焦点移动脸部发生扭曲。
解决办法是标记两个距离、保持浅景深，让焦平面干净利落地移动。

faq.a: 移焦是在一个镜头中把清晰焦平面从一个主体或距离移动到另一个。注意力发生变化而不需要剪辑，就像穿过纵深的一次拉焦。

faq.q: 移焦 vs 焦点转移
faq.a: 焦点转移是教科书式的两点转焦，构图保持不变；移焦则把同样的物理过程当作事件本身，包括慢速、快速或多次转焦。一个是程序，另一个是移动中的焦平面。

faq.q: 什么时候应该使用移焦？
faq.a: 当前景中的某个事实必须在一个镜头内把画面交给一张脸，或反过来时使用它。如果你需要两个平面都清晰，或者没有第二主体，就跳过它。

faq.q: 如何为AI图像或视频撰写移焦的提示词？
faq.a: 说明两个焦平面，表明清晰的焦平面从一个事实移动到另一个事实，而机身保持不动。对于视频，从前景物体拉焦到主体，或反向操作。

narrative: Someone in the foreground owns the frame, then the helix turns and a face in the room takes over. No cut.
The blur itself is the sentence. Use it when who matters changes while geography stays.
It is the wrong tool if both planes must stay readable at once, or if you only need a static shallow portrait. If nothing is sharp at either end, you did not shift focus.
how: Mark two distances. Keep depth of field shallow enough that only one plane is crisp, often a 50mm to 85mm near T2.
A follow-focus or remote motor walks the helical from A to B. The camera is usually locked or slow so the pull is the only event.
Lens breathing may thicken the image slightly as glass moves. Prompt a focal shift: the plane of sharpness traveling from one fact to another.
For video, pull from a foreground object onto the subject, or the reverse.
when: Use it for the beat when a glass, a gun, or a listener in the foreground yields to the person who must answer. Do not use it as decoration on a single face with no second plane.
vs: Rack Focus is the standard two-mark transfer, often about two seconds, composition held. Focal shift is the traveling plane as the event, including a slow rack, a snap rack, or several racks in a row.
Shallow Focus is a state: one plane already sharp. A shift is the move between states.
examples_film: The Graduate organizes attention between Benjamin and the figures around him by selective focus. There Will Be Blood uses the same grammar in hard interiors: who is true in the room changes without a cut.
mistakes: The usual wrong cousin is a cut, or a morph of detail during the pull. The tell is both planes sharp, or the face warping as focus moves.
The fix is two marked distances, shallow field, and a clean travel of the plane.

faq.q: What is focal shift in film?
faq.a: A focal shift moves the plane of sharpness from one subject or distance to another during a shot. Attention changes without cutting, as a pull through depth.

Rack focus is the textbook two-mark pull with the composition held. Focal shift is the same physics treated as the event itself, including slow, snap, or multiple racks. One is the procedure. The other is the traveling plane.

faq.q: When should I use focal shift?
faq.a: Use it when a foreground fact must hand the shot to a face, or the reverse, inside one take. Skip it if you need both planes sharp, or if there is no second subject.

faq.q: How do I prompt focal shift for AI image or video?
faq.a: Name both planes. Say the plane of sharpness travels from one fact to another while the camera body stays. For video, pull from a foreground object onto the subject, or the reverse.
